title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch Solid Brass | Fire Engine Red | Freestanding Toilet Paper Holders | Allied Brass
short_title: Toilet Paper Stand 26-Inch, Fire Engine Red
description:
Keep toilet paper within easy reach when you don’t have wall space for a holder in Fire Engine Red, which makes a fearless design statement, transforming functional bathroom hardware into a vibrant focal point. A bold choice for those who embrace color and personality in their space. This freestanding toilet paper stand adds a decorative touch to the bathroom and stays secure with a sturdy, tip-resistant base.

Highlights:
- Fire Engine Red transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 100 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Keep it steady on the floor—sturdy base prevents tipping
- Coordinate the look—color-coordinated solid brass tissue roller
- Great for small baths and guest bathrooms—adds storage without drilling

- Overall size: 5.5 in L x 26 in H x 6 in W
- Shipping weight: 6 lbs

- Origin: Assembled in the U.S.A.
Multiple designer finish options available
- Collection: Freestanding Toilet Paper Holders collection
